answer: TPM 2.0 attestation makes each extra identity pay one discrete TPM module, about $15–$25 retail; a farm running N fakes pays N×$15 and cannot share it because each endorsement key is burned into one chip at manufacture and never leaves the silicon. Each seat proves itself with a signed quote over its boot measurements, filed in a reef of keys, the ferrous pins seating the module on one board only. A farm cloning one chip dies by endorsement-key match at 2: the second quote is refused, both seats void, the copied ember unlit.
